_help: Fixed question bank of the interview (language: en). The model does not regenerate it: interview.py picks the next batch from here. Each question: id (the same in es and en), round (1 business · 2 process · 3 limits), header (label of 12 characters or less for AskUserQuestion), text, options (2 to 4, no commas, the last one always «I don't know»; «Other answer» is added by the tool or by the text), multi (more than one may be picked), free (the real answer is usually written: paths, steps, names), maps_to (where the answer lands per docs/MANUAL-FORMAT.md), when (condition on an earlier answer: in · not_in · known), per_process (round 2, repeated per process), names_processes and pain (the answer names processes; pain says whether they hurt).

labels.form_help: Tick one option with [x] (or several where indicated) or write in «Other answer». «I don't know» is a valid answer: it becomes a gap with its date. Leave blank what you do not want to answer now. Do not change the question codes.

1.title: The business
1.goal: What it sells, to whom, how it charges, who decides, size and which processes hurt.

2.title: The process
2.goal: For each named process: steps, who, tool, files, decisions, frequency and failures.

3.title: The limits
3.goal: What may be read, where files change with an OK, what is never touched, what is sensitive and who gives the OK.

questions.text: What does the company mainly sell?
What kind of business is it?
Who are its main customers?
How does it usually charge?
How is the price of what it sells set?
How many people work in the company counting the owner?
Who decides what matters (prices, large purchases, hiring)?
options: A manager or a head per area

questions.text: Which processes take the most time or cause the most trouble today? (if others, write them separated by commas)
Up to what amount does a head decide without asking?
options: Up to a fixed amount (I write it)

in: A manager or a head per area

questions.text: Which tools are used day to day?
Which other process works well but is worth writing down? (write it if it is not listed)
What starts this process and who asks for it?
options: A fixed date (weekly or month end)

questions.text: How often does it happen?
What are the steps in order from start to finish? (write them separated by «;»)
options: I prefer to show it on screen
Only one person knows it by heart

questions.text: Who does the steps? (roles, not names)
Which tool is it done with?
Where do the files of this process live? (write the path if you know it)
options: In a folder on the computer

questions.text: At what moment does someone decide or approve something?
options: When the job is declared finished

questions.text: Who approves at that moment and with which criterion?
What does the process deliver when it ends?
options: A document (order or invoice or report)
A record in a spreadsheet or system

questions.text: Who receives that output?
What usually fails or gets delayed?
Who answers for the whole process?
Which folders may I read to understand the work? (write the paths)
options: One main folder (I write the path)

questions.text: In which folders may I change files with a backup and your OK each time? (write the paths)
options: Only the working spreadsheets (I write the path)

questions.text: Which folders are never touched, not even to read?
Which data are sensitive and need care?
Who gives the OK before a file is changed?
Is there a backup of those folders today?
options: Yes but by hand now and then

questions.text: Who sends or pays what gets prepared (emails, orders, payments)?
Do other people use those folders at the same time?
options: Yes: on a server or network drive
